name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio: Jean-Pierre Dubois's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for snowmobiles in rural Quebec. This passion evolved into an engineering degree focused on vehicle dynamics. He started his career in a small open-wheel racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving under pressure. His approach to race engineering is rooted in meticulous data analysis and a collaborative spirit. He believes in empowering the driver with information while remaining adaptable to changing conditions. At Triple Eight, Jean-Pierre is known for his ability to extract performance gains from seemingly marginal adjustments, often finding innovative solutions that others overlook, despite his somewhat solitary work style.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a specific brand of coffee he insists on drinking before each race.
Tends to mutter technical jargon under his breath when concentrating.
